text: 10 OVERDOSAGE No cases of acute overdose have been reported in humans. No drug-related adverse effects were seen in dogs dosed with fidaxomicin tablets at 9600 mg/day (over 100 times the human dose, scaled by weight) for 3 months.

10 OVERDOSAGE No cases of acute overdose have been reported in humans. No drug-related adverse effects were seen in dogs dosed with fidaxomicin tablets at 9,600 mg/day (over 100 times the human dose, scaled by weight) for 3 months.
